Its caption gives the PHYSICAL table name ('PageLayout fields' -> PageLayout). Tables the viewer will not expose render a single cell 'Data for that table not supported'.

_note_definitions: The 'definition' (help text) string is retained only for tables NOT already present in docs/data-model/object-catalog.md; for catalogued tables it is omitted to keep this file small. Re-fetch the URL in _source to recover it.
_refusedTablesAreRecoverable: The 25 tables ShowObjectDetails.jsp refuses are NOT hidden from the product - all 25 appear in GET /rest/firm/types (227 names, a one-for-one match with this picker) and are addressable as /rest/businessObject/{type}. Their columns can be recovered by deep-serialising a record: GET /rest/businessObject/{type}/lxid/{id}?deep=true. This was done for the layout trio - see bbw-layout-engine-tables.json. Note the serializer emits only POPULATED columns, so REST-derived column lists are a lower bound, whereas ShowObjectDetails lists the declared schema.
